description: Save user-selected chat files as attachments for feedback and future news downloads. Requires an account connection. This stores original files; it does not parse documents or publish news. Reuse request_id for the same operation. Submit the returned ready attachment IDs with submit_feedback. Attach only files the user intends to provide for publication. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.
name: import_feedback_attachments
title: Attach files to feedback
